name: How long does a rotted window frame repair typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a rotted window frame repair typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a rotted window frame repair depends on the severity and location of the damage. A small, localized repair might be completed within a few hours to half a day per window. More extensive rot requiring significant wood replacement and intricate shaping could take a full day or longer. Factors like weather conditions and the need for paint drying time can also influence the overall timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies from a few hours for minor damage to a full day or more for extensive rot, depending on severity, complexity, and drying times.
